scripts.report:allure: allure generate allure-results --clean -o allure-report && allure open allure-report
scripts.visual: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e VISUAL_DOCKER=1 -e TEST_ENV=local mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble sh -c "node scripts/docker-forward.mjs & sleep 1 && npx playwright test --project=visual"
scripts.visual:update: docker run --rm --ipc=host -v "$PWD":/work -w /work -e VISUAL_DOCKER=1 -e TEST_ENV=local mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.64.1-noble sh -c "node scripts/docker-forward.mjs & sleep 1 && npx playwright test --project=visual --update-snapshots"
